en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tranquil pond in a landscaped city park. Several people are boating on the water in small rowboats and a canoe, while others walk along the curved stone embankment and near wide steps that lead up a grassy slope lined with bushes and trees. The reverse side has multilingual printed text identifying the location and a standard divided‑back layout with space for a stamp and address.
